chose: The game feed's scoreboard sleeps when no chosen game is live, past kickoff and not final within its grace, or within an hour of kickoff: it is next read an hour before the next chosen kickoff (CADENCE.margin, 3,600 s) or a day after its last read (CADENCE.refresh, 86,400 s), whichever is sooner (C888 adds a third: any listed game's end read, kickoff plus 4 h, and stays awake while such a game is still live, to kickoff plus 8 h), and never sooner than its 600 s awake cadence. Both are source policy constants with compile-time asserts (margin >= the scoreboard cadence and < refresh; refresh <= MAX_CADENCE). Backoff is unchanged.
options: margin 30 min (3 reads before kickoff), refresh 24 h
margin 1 h, refresh 6 h (4 reads a quiet day, a reschedule learnt within 6 h)
a fixed time-of-day refresh (e.g. 09:00 UTC) instead of a rolling day
gray: How many reads a quiet day costs against how soon a change is learnt is the owner's to notice; #3329's done-means names 'one daily scoreboard read' but no value for the margin.
undo: Change CADENCE.margin and CADENCE.refresh in game_feed.rs; nothing stores them.
